name: Motiv Medical
old_description: When your physician prescribes an orthopedic device, we take it from there. We verify your insurance, personally fit your device, and stand behind it until you’re back to what you love.
about:
Motiv Medical is based in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb of Cincinnati, and provides orthopedic device fitting and insurance coordination services. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates five service lines — bracing, bone growth stimulation, compression pumps, post-operative therapy, and wholesale — and serves patients across Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana, Michigan, West Virginia, and VA patients nationwide. Motiv Medical manages the full cycle from prescription receipt and insurance verification to in-person fitting at its Blue Ash office or the patient's home, followed by progress monitoring. The team includes certified fitters, billing specialists, and operational leaders with durable medical equipment experience. To date, the company reports fitting over 5,000 patients, working with more than 70 partner institutions and 325 referring physicians.

Motiv Medical works directly with patients, physicians, clinicians, and healthcare institutions. Its services support orthopedic care, post-surgical recovery, lymphedema management, and workers' compensation cases. The company is an exclusive national VA provider for Medi PCS Brio and Genius compression pumps through Lovell Government Services.

Motiv Medical differentiates itself by emphasizing personalized, in-person fitting rather than shipping devices directly to patients. It handles insurance, workers' compensation, VA, and direct-pay coordination, aiming to reduce administrative burden on providers and improve patient compliance and outcomes through concierge-level service.
